tips.text: Buy all three blueprints and start the Bo and Kunai builds first; run Alad V for the Neural Sensors, then farm Polymer while they rank.
Start the Kunai build as soon as its Nano Spores and Salvage are in, since it is the slowest ingredient.
Expect Polymer Bundle to be the only real complaint; players stall at 300 in 12 minutes without a loot frame.
